purpose: Requested fresh Boolean reward implementations, no method expansion.
eligible_domain: Native canonical True/False reference and corresponding Boolean answer semantics. No relabeling Yes/No,0/1, role sets or non-Boolean tasks.
freshness: Exclude prior content-exposed tasks including rejected candidates and previously exposed inherited/default scorer implementations. Deduplicate own scorers after removing docs/annotations and alpha-normalizing implementation identifiers; retain full AST/source hashes.
if_eligible: Freeze selected tasks and question-only researcher reference before model outputs
Use same prompt/schema/profile and explicit IR without defaults
No source/probes/oracle in extraction request; no contract supplementation
Run native Semgrep syntax baseline separately from source-symbolic reference control and source-symbolic LLM condition
Freeze concrete probe/oracle fields before detector predictions; compare active and violated obligation IDs
Retain Unknown and source-execution exceptions; no task replacement based on detector outcome
metrics_if_run: task-level source-exposed-since-method-freeze classification with supportedlabels only
Semgrep heuristic alerts separate from obligation-level proofs
LLM/reference selectedID omissions and modelvalidation status
if_insufficient: Do not run or fabricate an independent benchmark. Publish exact surveyed sources, incompatibilities, duplicates and unrun/undefined metrics. Keep prior frozen results.
